Now, take my hand.
...Braviiissssimo!!!
...You truly understood it.

You reminded me of the pure joy of racing!
"And that's why, on the turf, someone like you should—"

I raised my voice along with hers... Though I still
couldn't help wondering what "direttrice" actually meant.

Yet, I couldn't find the right words.
Even though I wanted so desperately to be her Trainer...!

...Whoops. No prestissimo, now.
This is a crucial passage. I must keep it meno mosso.

You don't need to say a word. I already know. Play it, and it will reach—
The moment you understood that, I knew.

Just as I was starting to doubt whether someone like me
could ever serve as a "direttore" (conductor)—

...That's it! If words fall short,
I'll use the method that reaches her heart the most—wordlessly!
Yes, what I yearn for is... the ultimate session!

I raised my voice along with hers... Though I still
couldn't help wondering what "direttore" actually meant.

Right then, the maracas inside my bag gave a rattle. I had forgotten
to return them yesterday, intending to hand them back when we met.

Her finishing kick on the straight is great. Her joyful running captivated me.
Her sunny, radiant presence is inspiring... All true, but not enough.

Sì! Then let our etude begin.
—Uno, due, tre, quattro!

May I ask you just one question?
—Why me?
Our prelude has only just begun!

Grazie!! 'O sole mio!!!
Ah, what a truly marvelous day—

...Oh? What is the matter, Trainer?
That's... yesterday's—
(Chak! Chaka-chaka-chak!)

Keep the tempo in mind.
I know you can do it! Comodo!
Simple words could never do this burning passion justice...!

This is it! The musica I have sought in a Trainer!!
Ah... ah! You truly are my destiny!

Hm...? ...Ah, I see.
...Heheh.

You reminded me of the pure joy of racing!
"And that's why, on the turf, I want someone like you to—"

To be honest, I can't say for sure whether I can make her win
in the Twinkle Series. But... even so!

Just as I was starting to doubt whether someone like me
could ever serve as a "direttrice" (conductor)—

The next day. The very first thing I did after officially becoming
Sounds of Earth's Trainer was not training—it was ensemble practice.

Fufu. There is no need to rush, Trainer.
Largo... Let us fill our staff notation slowly, gracefully.

...A part of me wondered if we shouldn't be training on the track instead.
Yet I understood this was her way of deepening our mutual bond, so—

"Hear my heart!" Pouring all my feelings into it, I shook the maracas.
She was the one who broadened my narrow perspective.

The finest Umamusume, the finest stage, the finest race... and beyond that,
a grandioso session! That is the very reason I run!

I felt ashamed for thinking I had figured her out.
In truth, her sharp intuition had simply read right through me.

...Hehe! Compared to the other angeli, I play rubato and am
quite difficult to handle, no? So tell me, why me?

Pouring every ounce of emotion into it,
I simply kept shaking the maracas with all my might—

Her careful attitude made it clear. —To forge a contract with her,
this answer is paramount. Hollow words won't suffice.

And then, I'd like to take the mezzo-forte in measure four
and make it fortissimo. It would resonate so much better, wouldn't it?
More passionate than salsa itself.

From this day forth, you are my direttore!
Together, let us play our melodia to the ends of the earth!!

From this day forth, you are my direttrice!
Together, let us play our melodia to the ends of the earth!!

Calm yourself, Direttore.
We have not reached the accelerando just yet.

The truth is, we have a session... a mock race coming up in two weeks.
So we must cultivate our armonia without delay!

Calm yourself, Direttrice.
We have not reached the accelerando just yet.

Sounds of Earth offered her hand, and I took it firmly.
I felt as though we were finally standing at the starting line.

Just how long had I been shaking those maracas...?
Exhausted, the moment I stopped playing—I heard applause.
Trainer. Shall we begin moderato for our opening?
